purpose: Offline audit of existing dataset and research artifacts before any new training or memory promotion.

scope.method: JSON schema, lineage, split, seed, family, negative-control and oracle-field inspection

decision.reason: No existing artifact satisfies the complete PG-30 train/dev/family-holdout/OOD/negative-control evidence contract.

observations.interpretation: replay consistency, not typed vulnerability detection

observations.scope: synthetic local targets only; no production vulnerability detection claim

findings.title: No complete PG-30 role matrix
findings.evidence: The audited reports do not provide one lineage-bound evidence object containing train, dev, family_holdout, ood_source and negative_control rows with independently verifiable metrics.

findings.title: Current capability gate does not detect sample/target/family split leakage
findings.evidence: app/model_capability_gate.py checks source_hash overlap only. It has no sample_id, probe_hash, dataset_manifest_hash, source_id or family field, so repeated samples or target instances can appear in multiple roles while the gate still evaluates them.

findings.title: Source lineage is not independently verifiable
findings.evidence: PG-23 prediction rows have no source_sha256 or target_instance_id; the payload source holdout explicitly rejects its provenance hash.

findings.title: Typed positive oracle evidence is absent or zero
findings.evidence: PG-28 and PG-29 have zero typed positives; the payload replay and maze reports have zero evaluator confirmations; PG-23 includes safe-canary diagnostics and non-zero held-out false-positive rates.

findings.title: Repeated seeds are not independent datasets
findings.evidence: PG-23 repeats the same sample IDs across 15 evaluations (627 rows but only 114 unique IDs). Seed changes alone do not establish new target/source cohorts.

findings.title: Aggregate metrics can hide cell regressions
findings.evidence: The gate consumes one baseline_metrics/candidate_metrics object and does not require per-role, per-family and per-seed denominators or worst-cell constraints.

findings.title: Safe dual-channel catalogs are useful negatives but not training positives
findings.evidence: PG-28/PG-29 contain fresh reset, GET/POST and negative controls, but remain evaluation-only with no typed positive authority.

required_repairs_before_data_collection: Add sample_id, family, source_id, dataset_manifest_sha256, split_manifest_sha256, probe_sha256, target_instance_id, oracle_contract_sha256 and checkpoint_sha256 to every gate row.
Reject any sample/probe/evidence/target overlap between train, dev, family_holdout, OOD and negative-control roles according to the frozen split policy.
Require per-role/per-family/per-seed metric cells with denominators, positive and negative counts, and worst-cell regression limits.
Require an attested typed positive oracle on held-out targets; reflection, HTTP status, replay consistency, timing or observable success alone are not positives.
Require every training/evaluation target to be fresh and require seed changes to alter a manifest selection/order hash.
Re-run the gate only on a newly collected, lineage-repaired dataset; keep all audited artifacts diagnostic or quarantined.
next_action: Collect a fresh multi-source dataset after the repairs; do not train or promote memory from any artifact listed above.
